name: kotlin_cache_lru
description: Kotlin LRU cache fixture exercising mutable maps, list ordering, replacement, lookup, and eviction paths.

exports.name: lruEvictionScore
exports.description: Inserts 1 and 2, touches 1, inserts 3, then checks that key 2 was evicted while 1 and 3 remain.

exports.name: lruUpdateScore
exports.description: Updates key 1 from 10 to 40 and verifies the replacement plus another resident value.

exports.name: lruCapacityOneScore
exports.description: Uses a capacity-one cache so inserting key 8 evicts key 7.
